## Autocomplete.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: Current text input value; bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever typed text or selected suggestion changes `value`.
- `onSelect` :: Called when an option is picked from the list.
- `options` :: Suggestion list (strings or rich objects).
- `placeholder` :: Placeholder displayed when empty.
- `size` :: Control height on the shared size ladder.
- `textSize` :: Text scale override independent of `size`.
- `shape` :: Corner family of the field frame, `rect` through `round`; it falls back to the enclosing Field's shape, then `modern`.
- `variant` :: Input frame visual appearance.
- `loading` :: Show a spinner while suggestions are loading asynchronously.
- `clearable` :: Show a clear button when `value` is non-empty.
- `disabled` :: Disable typing and opening suggestions.
- `invalid` :: Mark the input invalid.
- `emptyText` :: Text displayed inside the popup when no options match.
- `surface` :: The recipe behind the suggestion list: fill, border and shadow together. @default 'glass'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of a suggestion's description and of the empty row. @default 'text-xs'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the search icon, the descriptions and the empty row. @default 'text-muted'
